objects.description: [Salt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1045) has exploited CVE-2018-0171 in the Smart Install feature of Cisco IOS and Cisco IOS XE software for initial access.(Citation: Cisco Salt Typhoon FEB 2025)
